screening.unit: administrative dong x one registry type; not unique accommodation supply
screening.concentration: presence 2026 Jan-Oct 04 >= linear-interpolated p75 among valid dongs
screening.demand_axis: high concentration AND positive growth; false means one/both missing, not necessarily falling demand
screening.supply_axis: new registrations Jan01-Nov11 2026 minus2025 >0; absolute registration increase, not stock growth
screening.valid: 304 paired days at04 AND14; 31 paired OD October days; 2025 04 mean>=30 estimated persons
screening.low_sample_flags: presence prior mean<30 excluded; registrations prior new<5 and current<=5 flagged, not statistical sampling n; no significance claim
screening.period_mismatch: presence Jan-Oct; supply Jan01-Nov11; OD October; no causal synchronization
screening.low_registry: <=5 current spatially matched records in that one registry; not total physical supply
screening.micro_selection: 6 presence leaders +5 low-foreigner-registry presence leaders +5 growth leaders with prior presence>=100; no duplicates; max3 areas/gu; no composite score

evidence.confirmed: registry record statuses/events and published telecom estimated aggregates only
evidence.unavailable: dong occupied nights, bookable room inventory, occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, actual revenue, short-stay sex/age
forbidden: tourist+general lodging sum as unique supply
new minus closed as verified net supply

periods.presence_yoy: Jan01-Oct31 both years paired valid dates
periods.od: October2025 vsOctober2026, not annual, holidays not adjusted
periods.registry_snapshot: download2026-11-14, status01 registered operating not observed actual operation
periods.registry_events: Jan01-Nov11 each year; latest snapshot retrospective dates not complete event logs

units.presence: estimated persons present at selected hour
units.od: estimated repeated movement events per day; cross-dong inflow excludes within-dong
units.segment: estimated monthly arrivals including within-dong, per-source denominator
units.null: unavailable or zero denominator, never coerced to0
